en.title: Land advisory for Southern Chile | Land Advisors
en.description: Independent land advisory in Puerto Varas, Frutillar, Llanquihue and Malalcahuello. Market intelligence and local expertise so you buy land with clarity and confidence.

#inicio .hero-lead.en: We deliver market intelligence and local expertise so you evaluate, position, and buy land with confidence—around Lago Llanquihue and Malalcahuello.

#inicio .hero-metrics .hero-metric:nth-c.en: Buyers of land in Southern Chile

#problema .section-title.en: Clear guidance in a crowded market

#problema .section-intro.en: Listings are easy to find. What's harder is reading rural land near town, comparing options with real criteria, and knowing whether the price holds—before you travel south.

#problema .situacion-card:nth-child(1) ..en: «I saw dozens of listings and don't know which to compare»
Too much information, too little structure. We help you set filters before you visit.

#problema .situacion-card:nth-child(2) ..en: «I love the place — but does it fit my project?»
Home, cabins, or a business: we evaluate land use and surroundings before you make an offer.

#problema .situacion-card:nth-child(3) ..en: «I live in Santiago and don't know how things work locally»
Drive time, access, and how the area is changing—local expertise that shapes the decision.

#problema .situacion-card:nth-child(4) ..en: We separate strong opportunities from weak ones—and help you negotiate from that position.

#confianza .section-confianza__metric.en: More than 100,000 UF advised with clients

#consecuencias .section-intro.en: Independent advisory does not guarantee outcomes—but it helps you navigate risk before time and capital are committed.

#consecuencias .step:nth-child(1) p.en: Access, subdivision rules, or distance to services the listing barely mentioned.

#consecuencias .step:nth-child(2) p.en: Paying for the photo without checking real comps in the area.

#consecuencias .step:nth-child(3) p.en: Cabins or retail in mind—on land where that use is not viable.

#consecuencias .step:nth-child(4) p.en: Traveling south without priorities or a map—costly in time, thin on results.

#solucion .section-intro.en: We specialize in buyer-side land advisory in Southern Chile. Local expertise and market intelligence mean clearer options, stronger positioning, and guidance when you compare and negotiate.

#solucion .pensamos-lead.en: Local expertise. Clear decisions. A partner who already knows this basin.

#solucion .cards-bento .card:nth-child(1.en: Zones, pricing, and early signals—so every trip south is intentional.

#solucion .cards-bento .card:nth-child(2.en: Read what the listing leaves out
Access, subdivision rules, surrounding context, and where the area is headed—with clear guidance.

#solucion .cards-bento .card:nth-child(3.en: If it is not the right land, we say so—and keep searching with you.

#casos .section-intro.en: Three decisions around Lago Llanquihue. Past results do not guarantee future ones—they show how we work when market and field data align.

#casos .case:nth-child(1) h3 a.en: From a use restriction to commercial potential

#casos .case:nth-child(1) .case-dl dd:nt.en: Commercial-looking land with a ban on commercial use.
Access, traffic, and town growth that pointed to real commercial potential.
Acquired with the restriction in place; after it was lifted, about 50% upside vs. the price paid.

#casos .case:nth-child(2) .case-dl dd:nt.en: One more lot on the market.
A motivated seller and a gap between asking price and real value.
Acquired at 26 million; sold at 42 million in two months.

#casos .case:nth-child(3) .case-dl dd:nt.en: Developer liquidity pressure—and upside once the project advanced.
Four lots for 4,400 UF; recent comps near ~2,000 UF per lot.

#servicios .section-title.en: Advisory across every stage of the land process

#servicios .section-intro.en: Each engagement covers a distinct stage. Most clients begin with a strategy call (Diagnostic, 1 UF).

#servicios .service-card:nth-child(1) p.en: Clarify zones, budget, and a visit plan—so you move forward with structure.

#servicios .service-card:nth-child(2) p.en: At least four options—then we narrow to the three best with you and deliver a clear comparison.

#servicios .service-card:nth-child(3) p.en: Negotiation and closing support—aligned with your interests, not a listing to push.

#servicios .service-card:nth-child(3) .s.en: minus 5 UF if you already engaged search

#servicios .service-card:nth-child(4) p.en: Evaluate whether this land is a strong buy—before you commit capital.

#servicios .service-card:nth-child(5) p.en: Cabins, tourism, or retail: feasibility and a plan before you build.

#oportunidades .section-title.en: Three steps to a confident decision

#oportunidades .section-intro.en: A clear process—whether you are buying to live, invest, or develop.

#oportunidades .step:nth-child(1) p.en: A strategy call to lock budget, timing, and what you want the land to deliver.

#oportunidades .step:nth-child(2) p.en: Zones, pricing, access, and risk signals—backed by fieldwork and market comps.

#oportunidades .step:nth-child(3) p.en: A clear recommendation, negotiation support when needed, and guidance if you should keep searching.

#faq .faq-item:nth-child(1) .faq-answer.en: No. We are independent land advisors—not a brokerage or listing portal. We guide buyers, with no inventory of our own to sell.

#faq .faq-item:nth-child(2) .faq-answer.en: A strategy call (Diagnostic, 1 UF): we understand your objective and deliver zones and criteria before you begin visiting land.

#faq .faq-item:nth-child(3) summary.en: Does this work if I live in Santiago?

#faq .faq-item:nth-child(3) .faq-answer.en: Yes. Many clients live outside the region. We help you arrive with a map and priorities—so every visit is intentional.

#faq .faq-item:nth-child(4) summary.en: What if the land I like is not a strong buy?

#faq .faq-item:nth-child(4) .faq-answer.en: We provide clear guidance and keep searching with you. Our role is a sound purchase—not a fast one.

#faq .faq-item:nth-child(5) .faq-answer.en: Lago Llanquihue and Malalcahuello: Puerto Varas, Frutillar, Llanquihue, Ensenada, Puerto Octay, and rural land near those towns.

#contacto-form-intro.en: Tell us where you are in the process. After you submit, pick a calendar slot or confirm with José on WhatsApp.

#contacto .contact-info p:nth-of-type(5).en: We work with long-term investors, families seeking quality of life, developers, and local business owners across Southern Chile.

#contacto-form .form-hint.en: Most clients begin with a strategy call (Diagnostic) to structure the search.

.contact-success__title.en: How would you like to continue?

.contact-success__lead.en: Land Advisors has your details. Choose the next step:

.contact-success__note.en: Strategy call ~30 min · Online or in Puerto Varas · We reply Mon–Fri.

#cta h2.en: Ready to navigate your next land decision?

#cta p.en: A ~30-minute strategy call to clarify your objective—with no obligation to buy.

#innovacion .section-title.en: Data and tools that support clearer decisions

#innovacion .section-intro-wide.en: When we compare land to acquire or evaluate a cabin, retail, or development concept, we combine maps, satellite review, public records, and AI with fieldwork. Technology does not replace walking the land—it helps you move forward with greater precision.

#territorios .section-intro.en: We focus on the Lago Llanquihue and Malalcahuello basin—especially rural land near the main towns. For broader Patagonia briefs we also deliver custom search with local partners and site visits when the assignment requires it.

#nosotros .about-copy p:nth-of-type(1).en: Land Advisors Chile is led by José Hernán Katz C.—a specialist in land strategy, acquisitions, and project feasibility across Southern Chile.

#nosotros .about-copy p:nth-of-type(2).en: We combine fieldwork with GIS, mapping, and AI so families, investors, and operators can evaluate land and projects with clarity and confidence.

#nosotros .about-copy p:nth-of-type(3).en: We understand land from the ground up: we walk the roads, visit the sites, and learn places from the inside—then back that understanding with checkable data.

#partners .section-intro.en: We work with strong local partners to help you advance your project in Southern Chile.

#innovacion .inno-card--hero p.en: We connect AI to our library of zoning notes, maps, market comps, and field experience. Guidance comes with sources you can check—not a generic chatbot response.

#innovacion .inno-card:nth-child(2) p.en: Land use, access, and town growth layered into one read of the area.

#innovacion .inno-card:nth-child(3) p.en: Google Earth and remote sensing to identify patterns the listing price has not yet reflected.

#innovacion .inno-card:nth-child(4) h3.en: AI on market and zoning data

#innovacion .inno-card:nth-child(4) p.en: We process regulatory and real-estate data at scale—with a trail back to the source.

#innovacion .inno-card:nth-child(5) p.en: Public data, planning maps, local market, and site visits in a single decision flow.

#innovacion .inno-card--wide p.en: We use tools so human judgment—after you have walked the land—lands in a clear buy, pass, or negotiate call aligned with your goals.
